chunk.text: Bro, now I will ask you all a few questions. Basically, I will ask one person. Before you explain, I will ask a rapid-fire question. You answer first—there won't be any time to think. Then I will give you some time to explain your reasoning. One question, please. This is football: this or that. Oh no, with VJR! Are you ready? I am born ready, my friend. Ronaldo winning the World Cup or Neymar winning the World Cup? Cristiano Ronaldo winning the World Cup. Noida City winning the league or Madrid winning the 16th UCL? Noida City. I am a loyal guy. Klopp or Enrique as the next coach for Real Madrid?

Klopp. One UCL night to relive: La Decima final or 2022 vs Manchester City comeback? La Decima final. I slept in the second half—I want to watch it again. Honestly, there is no explanation. But yeah, we're done. We won because he slept in the second half. You were rapid, and I think that's a win. By the way, both places are professional, but you took Noida City—respect. Thank you so much. We are loyal, bro. Muktesh Markaroni, are you ready for football this or that?

Bro, who prepared these questions? Noida City or Barcelona? Barcelona. Barcelona losing the Champions League final or losing La Liga on the last day? Losing La Liga—we have won the Champions League before. Jamal or Pedri—who wins the Ballon d'Or first? Jamal, obviously, because that is how the game works. Barcelona can only sign one player next season.

Striker or center-back? Striker. You have to start one player every game next season: Araujo or Ferran? Oh my God, that’s a good one. Ferran. Bro, he needs to explain. It’s a tough choice, but I would start Ferran every game. I have no other choice. And your reasoning? I think Barcelona needs a striker more.

We create a lot of chances, but we need better finishing. At the same time, we depend heavily on our defensive structure and build-up. Still, if I have to pick, I choose Ferran. Ferran Torres is Barcelona’s third-highest goalscorer. Respect. Mohak Bhai, are you ready? Football this or that with Mohak.

United makes top 4 and Bruno leaves, or Bruno stays and United misses out? Top 4, even if Bruno leaves. If you could bring back one player, Rashford or McTominay? McTominay. If Carlo Ancelotti agrees to join United, would you keep Carrick or bring Ancelotti? Of course, Ancelotti—the greatest coach. Choose one rival player: Gravenberch or Ekitike? I will pick Ekitike.
Why so many options? Still, I would pick Ekitike. Now explain: you would let Bruno go for top 4? Yes, I would do it. But why not Rashford over McTominay? That’s a crazy choice.
Because McTominay was committed. Rashford was giving interviews. McTominay left respectfully. Rashford did win trophies, but still. Let's move to Divyansh. Football this or that.

For Madrid next season: Zidane 2016 style or Carlo 2020 style? Carlo 2020. Would you move to Saudi Arabia at 25 or play in the Premier League outside the top 6? Premier League outside top 6. Pep or Klopp? Klopp. Fight Zlatan or get a career-ending tackle from Messi? Fight Zlatan. Last question: striker with 5 goals a season or goalkeeper who never saves penalties? Goalkeeper.

You would really play outside the top 6 your whole career? I doubt it. Divyansh is going crazy. Ask me, I will do a rapid fire. Chonky, your turn: 10 chole bhature at once or 10 golgappas? Chole bhature.
What is more problematic—the question or the answer? This is too much. Calm down.
